propositions: The warn_if_cache_ineffective predicate fires on every small call below 4096 tokens with zero cache counters, despite this being the expected and correct behavior for sub-floor prompts.
The warning cannot distinguish between 'cacheable prompt silently failed to cache' (actionable defect) and 'prompt below the 4096-token cache floor' (expected, unactionable).
Multiple warnings per run (circa 20 per rebar review-plan) train operators to filter the signal, making it ineffective when a model genuinely stops caching.
The warning contradicts the run's own aggregate usage telemetry when caching works at the run level but individual sub-floor calls report zero counters.
The CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS floor constant is defined in pass1.py but the warning in structured_run.py does not consult it, creating a design invariant violation.
